title: Rezoning to allow taller housing at 1166 Bedford Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This zoning map amendment changes property near 1166 Bedford Avenue in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn from an R6A to an R7X district. Combined with a related text amendment, it would allow a new 12-story mixed-use building with about 144 income-restricted apartments, 13,400 square feet of community facility space and 4,800 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The City Council approved the change on July 14, 2026.
